Record Class PlayAnimationPayload

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.animationlib.impl.net.PlayAnimationPayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload
public record PlayAnimationPayload(int entityId, net.minecraft.resources.Identifier animationId, int cameraFollowEntityId, String cameraFollowBone, boolean forceThirdPerson, String soundId, int soundEntityId) extends Record implements net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload
Serverbound, it's a play request from a client for its own player; entityId is ignored and re-derived from the sender. Clientbound, it's the resulting broadcast telling a client to start playing animationId on the player identified by entityId.

cameraFollowEntityId is -1 and cameraFollowBone is "" when no camera-follow target is set; use resolvedCameraFollowEntityId() and resolvedCameraFollowBone() to read them back as nullable values.
